draft.author: Lance Zierlein
draft.strengthQuote: Looks the part off the bus with athletic, chiseled frame.
draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 7.00, the 1st-best grade among 253 2019 draftees and 1st of 21 at DT. He went 19th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Ndamukong Suh. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 2 sacks in 2018, 17th of 21 DTs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 8 pro, currently with the Tennessee Titans. 99 career games and 97 starts over 7 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Producing near his peak: 14 AV in 2025 against a career-best 14 in 2021. Strengths in 2025: tackles for loss 17 (100th percentile), sacks 11.0 (99th percentile), approximate value 14 (99th percentile). Versus the typical Year-7 interior lineman who played: 32 pressures against a median of 4, above the norm.
